verdict.rationale: Meltano docs confirm dbt transformations run as part of the same pipeline via `meltano run` (integrating extract, load, and transform in one invocation), rather than dbt being scheduled independently on a timer. However, evidence doesn't explicitly describe dependency-aware triggering (e.g., transformation only firing after successful load completion, or handling partial load failures) beyond the general run command and Airflow orchestration mention. missing for 10: explicit documentation of load-completion-triggered dbt runs, freshness/dependency checks, and independent/hands-on confirmation that transformations don't run on a blind schedule.
